info.desc: Melodrama is the second studio album by New Zealand singer Lorde, released on June 16, 2017, through Lava and Republic Records and distributed through Universal. Following the breakthrough success of her debut album Pure Heroine, Lorde retreated from the spotlight, and travelled between New Zealand and the United States to examine the world around her. Initially inspired by her disillusionment with fame, she wrote Melodrama to capture heartbreak and solitude after her first breakup. "Melodrama" has been described by critics as a loose concept album that explores the theme of solitude, in the framework of a single house party with the events and moods that entail it. podcast.body: This album was chosen as the Album of the Year by New Musical Express (NME) and was also recognized by many other publications as the second-best album of the year. It is described as excellent, very interesting, and very complete, a remarkable achievement for Lorde, who is often considered a mainstream artist. Cosmopolitan magazine also selected it as their best album. "un disco buenísimo, interesantísimo y completísimo, a pesar de ser del Lord, que se suele considerar como una artista gran consumo, pues ha hecho un disco fantástico."

srcs.episode: El Disco del Año 2017: Según cada publicación

podcast.body: This album was fantastic, purchased in China shortly after its release. It demonstrated that Lorde had reached new levels of quality, surprising many. It is an intimate work with very good, well-crafted lyrics and a clean sound, distinct from her debut album, *Pure Heroine*, sounding much newer, more adult, and less adolescent. "es un álbum fantástico a intimista con letras muy buenas muy bien trabajadas ese sonido tan limpio pero no suena tanto a ese primer trabajo que teníamos el piorgero ínsino que suena como mucho más nuevo mucho más adulto mucho menos adolescente."
